Q2 2026 update: The average electricity price in the world is USD 0.176 kWh for residential users and USD 0.164 USD per kWh for businesses. The highest residential electricity prices are in Europe at USD 0.254 per kWh and the lowest are in Asia with USD 0.088. Africa (0.14), Oceania (0.261), North America (0.153), and South America (0.213) are in between.

The highest business electricity prices are in Oceania at USD 0.266 per kWh and the lowest prices are in Africa (0.133) and Asia (0.107). On the other continents: Europe (0.213), North America (0.165), and South America (0.203).

World Average Electricity Prices, USD / kWh

The world average electricity price increased by 1.02 percent for households and by 0.44 percent for businesses since Q1 2026. On an annual basis, household rates increased by 6.12 percent and business rates increased by 3.76 percent since Q2 2025.


European Average Electricity Prices, USD / kWh

Electricity prices in Europe decreased by 0.39 percent for households and by 3.46 percent for businesses compared to Q1 2026. Annually, European electricity rates increased by 3.70 percent for households and by 3.73 percent for businesses since Q2 2025.
